# Maya Research Cookbook

> Public cookbook for Maya Research voice models: API references, runnable TTS recipes, LiveKit, Pipecat, and voice agents from scratch. Current tested model (8 September 2026): Maya Calyx, with 24 selected speakers. Default voice: Aarav. Use the dated cookbook catalog. Start small; read validation before claiming a path is verified. Future model releases require updated examples and tests.

## Start
- [Coding-agent instructions](AGENTS.md): setup, safety and evidence rules.
- [Python TTS](quickstarts/python/README.md): one request to a checked WAV, no packages.
- [TypeScript TTS](quickstarts/typescript/README.md): server-side Node.
- [curl TTS](quickstarts/curl/README.md): response validation before conversion.

## Voice agents
- [LiveKit](integrations/livekit/README.md): pinned Maya-maintained plugin.
- [Pipecat](integrations/pipecat/README.md): maintained community package, local WebRTC.
- [Streaming](examples/streaming-tts/README.md): readiness, PCM, single-use turns, cancellation.
- [From scratch](examples/voice-agent-from-scratch/README.md): microphone or synthetic WAV, STT, LLM, Maya, speaker.
